sintoma: Chamado #5405 — “WPA2 está on”, mas clientes modernos recusam e o scanner de compliance marca cipher fraco.
cli_output:
WLC# show wlan 8
SSID............................................. StoreFloor
Security
   Wi-Fi Protected Access (WPA/WPA2)............ Enabled
   WPA.......................................... Enabled
   WPA2......................................... Enabled
      AES Cipher................................ Disabled
      TKIP Cipher............................... Enabled
   AKM
      PSK....................................... Enabled
      802.1X.................................... Disabled

WLC# show wlan 8 | include Cipher|WPA|AKM|Security
WPA2......................................... Enabled
AES Cipher................................ Disabled
TKIP Cipher............................... Enabled
PSK....................................... Enabled

Client modern OS:
Cannot join — weak security / TKIP not allowed (lab summary)

! Compliance: TKIP-only equivalent; AES absent
alternativas: AES Cipher Enabled e TKIP Disabled no output
Security WPA completamente Disabled
Open System authentication only
WPA2 “on” mas só TKIP (AES Disabled) — cipher legado; falta AES/CCMP para hardening moderno
explicacao_profunda: WPA2 Enabled com AES Disabled e TKIP Enabled + PSK. Label “WPA2” não basta sem AES. Clientes novos recusam TKIP. Habilite AES (idealmente AES-only) e desligue TKIP. Não é Open nem WPA total off.
